title: Women's Christmas – Santa Gets All the Credit Tee
hook: This funny Christmas tee gives the mom who did the shopping, the wrapping and the hiding the last word: Santa gets ALL THE CREDIT. A gift tied with a big pink bow, a tape dispenser down to its last inch and a pair of scissors are the three things that actually made Christmas happen, and she knows it. Wear it to the family dinner, or hand it to the mom on your christmas gifts for mom list.
art: The print is a small cluster in cherry red, soft pink and pine green: a square red gift tied with a large pink satin bow, a vintage tape dispenser nearly out of tape, and open pink-handled scissors, with a few holly sprigs and a curl of ribbon between them. Santa gets sits above in red italic and ALL THE CREDIT sits below in pine green slab capitals with a thin pink edge.
wear: Wear it to the wrapping-paper marathon, the Christmas Eve dinner or the office party, or give it to the mom, sister or friend who handles every present in the house.
qa: What is the Santa Gets All the Credit tee?

It is a women's relaxed Christmas tee from Graphic Tees Co. with a wrapped gift, a pink bow, a tape dispenser and scissors, lettered Santa gets ALL THE CREDIT. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 6400 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light under a cardigan or a Christmas apron.
How does the women's relaxed tee fit?

This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL with a crew neck. Order your usual size for an easy fit or size up one for an oversized look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free within 30 days.
How do I wash it so the print lasts?

Wash your Santa Gets All the Credit tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the red, pink and green inks stay bright through the holidays.
Is it a good Christmas gift for mom?

Yes. It suits the mom, sister or friend who does the shopping, wrapping and hiding, and kids or a partner can order it as a thank-you. It is $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. in six colors, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Santa Gets All the Credit tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
